{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_bond_group_dwarves}Let it be carved in stone. From this day you are sworn to my halls. My axes guard your door, you may bear arms in my name, and nothing of yours shall be taken but by the law of the halls.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_bond_group_orcs}Right. From now on you are mine. My band has your back, you carry steel for me, and nobody takes your share unless I say so.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_bond_group_sauron}It is done. You are mine now. My power shelters you, you bear arms in my name, and nothing you hold is yours but by my will.

{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_bond_group_saruman}Then it is agreed. From this day you are sworn to me. You have the protection of Isengard and the right to bear arms in my name, and none shall touch what is yours without my leave.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_bond_group_nazgul}It is sealed. From this night you are sworn to us. Our shadow covers you, you bear arms in our name, and none will take what is yours.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_west}You have chosen well, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve faithfully, and the realm will not forget it.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_rohirrim}A good choice, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve the Mark well and you will ride high in it.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_northmen}You have done well, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve faithfully, and you will rise.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_dunlendings}Wise, {PLAYER.NAME}. Stand with us, and the clans will lift you high.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_southrons}A wise bargain, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve me well, and you will be richly rewarded.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_easterlings}You chose well, {PLAYER.NAME}. Ride with us, and you will rise high.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_elves}You have chosen wisely, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve us faithfully, and you will be honoured among us.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_dwarves}A sound bargain, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve well and you will have a place of honour in my halls.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_orcs}Smart, {PLAYER.NAME}. Do as you are told and you will get a fat share.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_sauron}You have chosen the only road that does not end in ruin, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve me well, and you will rise.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_saruman}A wise choice, {PLAYER.NAME}. Wiser than you know. Serve me well and you will rise.
{=taom_enc_liege_vassal_welcome_group_nazgul}You have chosen, {PLAYER.NAME}. Serve, and you will be raised up.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_west}You would fight for coin? We have need of good swords on our borders. For every band of the enemy you break, or any deed of like worth, you will have {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_rohirrim}Riding for pay, is it? The Mark can use spears. For every band of foes you break, or any deed as worthy, you will be paid {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_northmen}Looking for paid work? We pay well for steel. Every band of enemies you put down, or any deed as good, earns you {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_dunlendings}Want silver for your sword? We have plenty of enemies. For every band of them you break, or a deed as good, you get {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_southrons}You seek paid work? The south pays in gold for good blades. For every band of enemies you destroy, or any deed of equal worth, you will have {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_easterlings}Riding for pay? We have many enemies and much plunder. For every band of foes you scatter, or any deed as great, you take {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_elves}You would serve for payment? We do not love it, but the Shadow grows. For every band of the enemy you defeat, or any deed of like worth, you will receive {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_dwarves}You want paid work? Dwarves pay their debts. For every band of enemies you break, or any deed of like worth, you will have {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}, counted to the last coin.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_orcs}Want to kill for pay? Good, there's plenty to kill. Every enemy band you smash, or something as good, gets you {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_sauron}You would serve for gold? The Tower has gold enough. For every band of my enemies you destroy, or any deed of like worth, you will be paid {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_saruman}You seek employment? Isengard has work for capable hands. For every band of my enemies you break, or any deed of like worth, you will receive {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_pitch_group_nazgul}You would serve for coin? There is coin enough in the dark. For every band of our enemies you destroy, or any deed as worthy, you will have {MERCENARY_AWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_west}Good. The scribes will draw up the contract. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, I welcome you. Turn your blade against our enemies.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_rohirrim}Good. The contract will be written. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. May your spear find our enemies.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_northmen}Good. We will put it in writing. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Put your blade to good use against our foes.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_dunlendings}Good. It will be marked down. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Turn your blade on those who stole our land.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_southrons}Good. The contract will be sealed. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, I welcome you. May your blade drink deep of our enemies.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_easterlings}Good. The terms will be written. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Let our enemies learn your name.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_elves}So be it. The terms will be set down. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Let your blade be turned against the Enemy.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_dwarves}Good. The contract will be cut in runes. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Send our enemies back to the dark they crawled from.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_orcs}Good. Somebody will scratch it down. For the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are in. Now go and kill our enemies.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_sauron}Good. It is recorded. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are taken into my service. Let my enemies fall before you.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_saruman}Excellent. The terms will be written. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, I welcome you. Put your sword to good use.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_group_nazgul}It is written. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are taken in. Go, and hunt.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_empire}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you take our silver. Help us win back the land the horse-lords stole.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_empire_w}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Gondor stands between the West and the Shadow; help it stand.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_empire_s}It is recorded. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, your sword belongs to Mordor. The West will learn to fear it.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_sturgia}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Keep the merchants' roads safe and our foes far from the Lonely Mountain.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_aserai}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Ride with the serpent banner, and let our enemies feel the heat of Harad.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_vlandia}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Ride with the Eorlingas, and let our foes hear the horns of Rohan.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_battania}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you take our pay. Fight hard and the plunder of the West is yours to share.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_khuzait}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Ride with the host, and share in the spoils of the West.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_erebor}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Erebor pays its debts in good gold. Earn it.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_rivendell}So be it. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Guard the passes and the fords, and keep the Shadow from the valley.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_mirkwood}Very well. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Clear the forest of spiders and orcs, and you will be paid in full.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_lothlorien}So be it. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Guard the borders of the Golden Wood, and you will not go unrewarded.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_isengard}Excellent. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are taken into my employ. The White Hand rewards those who serve it well.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_gundabad}Good. For {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are in. Kill dwarves, kill elves, and get paid for it.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_umbar}Done. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, the Havens welcome you. Fill our ships with plunder and Gondor's ports with fear.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_dolguldur}It is written. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you serve Dol Guldur now. Hunt our enemies through the dark of the forest.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_shaghana}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Fight well, and the riches of the south will be yours to share.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_abanissa}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Serve Âbanissa well, and you will be paid in full.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_goblin}Good. For the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are in. Bring us loot and prisoners, and you get your cut.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_mistymountainorcs}Good. For the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are in. Kill whatever comes up the passes, and you get paid.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_bluecraig}Good. For the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you're in. Bring back loot, and you get a share.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_lindon}So be it. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Guard the last shores of the Eldar, and you will be rewarded.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_arthedain}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, you are welcome. Hold the North against Angmar's shadow.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_cardolan}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Guard our downs and barrows, and keep our enemies from our borders.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_rhudaur}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Fight for the hills, and you will be paid.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_eredluin}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. The halls of Ered Luin pay fair for honest work.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_anduinvale}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Keep the river and the passes safe, and you will be paid.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_angaladh}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Fight for Angáladh, and you will be paid.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_dorwinion}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Guard our vineyards and our river trade, and you will be paid in coin and in wine.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_accept_realm_southrhovanion}Good. In the name of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, welcome. Hold the plains against the East, and you will be paid.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_west}Think on it, then. But when the Shadow comes, be sure you stand on the right side of the wall.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_rohirrim}Think on it. But choose quickly. When the war-horns sound, there are only two sides of the field.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_northmen}Think it over. Only do not end up on the losing side of the river.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_easterlings}Think on it. But the horde does not wait for the slow.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_elves}Think on it. The years are long for us, but not for you, and the darkness is gathering.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_dwarves}Weigh it, then. But a dwarf does not forget who stood beside the halls, and who stood aside.

{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_saruman}Think it over. But do be careful not to end up on the losing side.
{=taom_enc_liege_merc_decline_group_nazgul}Consider. But the Shadow does not wait.

{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_dwarf_1}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}, a smith of the old guild. The stonecutters and metalworkers of {TOWN_NAME} bring their quarrels to my anvil, and I speak for them in the halls.

{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_dwarf_2}{CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}, at your service. I work the forge, as my kin have done since the first halls were hewn. The craft guilds of {TOWN_NAME} trust me to speak for them.
{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_dwarf_3}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. Stone and steel are my trade. When the masons and jewellers of {TOWN_NAME} need a voice before the lords, it is mine they send.

{=taom_enc_notable_headman_dwarf_1}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. My kin have worked the mines and terraces of {VILLAGE_NAME} for more generations than the elders can count. The miners and herders here ask me to speak for them.
{=taom_enc_notable_headman_dwarf_2}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I keep the stores and the tally of {VILLAGE_NAME}, as my elders did before me. Every hearth here sends its word through me.

{=taom_enc_notable_headman_dwarf_3}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. Ore and barley both come out of the ground at {VILLAGE_NAME}, and both need careful hands. The diggers and growers of this place, my kin among them, let me speak for them.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_dwarf_1}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I hold the claim to the seams and pastures hereabouts, and many in this village answer to my word.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_dwarf_2}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. The quarry above this village is my family's by old right, and the workers here look to me.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_dwarf_3}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. These lands were granted to my house when the halls were young. I speak for many who dwell in this village.

{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_elf_1}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I am a maker, as the Eldar reckon it: wood, thread and silver take shape under my hands. The makers of {TOWN_NAME} ask me to give their counsel a voice.
{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_elf_2}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. For many long years I have shaped bows and fine things in {TOWN_NAME}, and the weavers and carvers here let me speak for them.

{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_elf_3}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. Some of us keep the old crafts alive, so that they are not lost as the years pass. Those who work with skill in {TOWN_NAME} have chosen me to speak for them.

{=taom_enc_notable_headman_elf_1}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I keep watch over the glades about {VILLAGE_NAME}, as my kindred have since the trees were young. Those who tend the woods here speak through me.

{=taom_enc_notable_headman_elf_2}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}, warden of {VILLAGE_NAME}. We take from the land only what it gives freely, and the growers and gatherers here trust me to keep it so.

{=taom_enc_notable_headman_elf_3}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. Many seasons have I watched turn over {VILLAGE_NAME}. The gardeners and foresters of this place, my kindred among them, ask me to speak for them.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_elf_1}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. The groves around this village are in my keeping, and many here heed my counsel.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_elf_2}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. My kindred were given the care of these lands long ago, and I speak for many who dwell in this village.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_elf_3}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I hold the woods and meadows hereabouts in trust, and this village looks to me when it must be heard.

{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_orc_1}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I run the forges in {TOWN_NAME}. Every smith and driver in the work pits answers to me, so if you want something made, you talk to me.
{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_orc_2}{CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I'm boss of the pits here in {TOWN_NAME}. The hammer gangs do what I say, and they speak when I let them.
{=taom_enc_notable_artisan_orc_3}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. Iron, rope, arrows, whatever the war needs, my gangs in {TOWN_NAME} make it, and they make it fast or they answer to me.
{=taom_enc_notable_headman_orc_1}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}, taskmaster of {VILLAGE_NAME}. The thralls work the fields because I keep them at it. Anything this place says, it says through me.
{=taom_enc_notable_headman_orc_2}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. I keep the pens and the fields of {VILLAGE_NAME}, and the grubbers here do as I tell them, or they don't eat.
{=taom_enc_notable_headman_orc_3}I'm {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. Somebody has to drive the thralls and fill the carts in {VILLAGE_NAME}. That somebody is me, so you talk to me.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_orc_1}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. This land is mine because I took it and I hold it. The village does what I say.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_orc_2}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. Every field and pen around here pays its share to me, and the whole lot of this village answers to my word.
{=taom_enc_notable_rural_orc_3}I am {CONVERSATION_HERO.FIRSTNAME}. The big boss gave me these lands to squeeze. I speak for this village, whether it likes it or not.
